entities.summary: Toll Yagami (b. 1962-08-19, Takasaki) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Takasaki and Japan. Known in the fields of japan, composers & musicians, asia.
